description: Intrinsic dimensionality via PCA on mean-centered L2-normalized embeddings
note: Raw embeddings are L2-normalized (sentence-transformers). Centering before PCA gives meaningful eigenvalue analysis.
key_findings: Overall: 100 components for 90% variance (high intrinsic dimensionality)
Confirms dataset requires many dimensions to represent, not low-rank
Each pipeline occupies a different subspace of the 384-dim embedding space
